test_policy.notes: The admissions page states test score submission is optional and the Apply page says no tests are required. An older Admissions Terminology page still says first-year students must submit ACT/SAT (no minimum score); the current pages take precedence. Freshman English-proficiency alternatives: SAT EBRW 520+ or ACT English 20+.

requirements.notes: No application fee for freshmen. Apply through UIW's portal, ApplyTexas or the Common App; international applicants use the separate international application (applyintl.uiw.edu). Required: online application, official high school transcript in English, proof of English proficiency, passport copy and any US visa, proof of financial support. A minimum 2.5 GPA (4.0 scale) is required for unconditional admission. The international page prints no application fee.

deadlines.label: Rolling admission: no international application deadline published (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: UIW says applications are accepted all year and reviewed on a rolling basis. The international page prints no deadline; allow time for the I-20 and visa. Contact intladmis@uiwtx.edu to confirm.

deadlines.label: Freshmen encouraged to apply by Nov. 1 (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: The freshman admissions page encourages applying by Nov. 1 for the following fall; it does not say this applies to international applicants and prints no year (treated as fall 2027).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt: graduates of US high schools; international or bi-national curriculum schools that award a US diploma, hold US regional accreditation or offer the IB diploma; third-country nationals who completed secondary or tertiary education in Australia, Canada (excluding Quebec), New Zealand or the UK (other English-speaking countries case by case). Freshman alternatives: SAT EBRW 520+, ACT English 20+, WAEC/SSCE English C4+, GCSE/IGCSE English First Language C+, KCSE English C+. TOEIC 650 is also accepted. Applicants below the minimum can be conditionally admitted into an ESL pathway with UNAM - San Antonio (see aid notes).

english.notes: The page lists no minimum for the new 1-6 TOEFL.
Cambridge Advanced (CAE) at level C1; the page gives no numeric score.

aid.notes: First-time freshmen are automatically considered for academic scholarships based on high school GPA: $9,000-$22,000 per year (effective Fall 2026); the page gives no per-GPA tiers. Renewal needs a 2.0 cumulative GPA and 12 UIW credits each semester. 15% tuition discounts (Fall 2026) for undergraduates applying independently of an agent from Latin America, or from Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand or Vietnam. CDS H6: 150 nonresidents received institutional aid, average $28,829. Conditional admission: UIW partners with UNAM - San Antonio for intensive English; students may apply without English scores, UNAM issues an I-20 for English courses only, intakes August and January (the page does not say how students move into degree courses). No international need-based aid is described.

sat.note: UIW pages read do not print a numeric SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: UIW pages read do not print a numeric ACT code; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed on the pages read (UIW lists code 6303 for TOEIC only).
